features: Licences for 8 recording channels and 2 client accesses included
Storage capacity up to 36 TB without RAID
RAID 1 recording is a licensed option
Second Ethernet port requires licence DLC - ViProxy Plus (007642)
Video compression H.264, H.265; audio G.722.1
8 GB flash module for operating system and application
notes: Analogue inputs (24x CVBS/BNC) need Mounting Kit 003815, Encoder Boards 003816 and licences for channels 9 to 24; the total stays at 24 video streams.
Microphone input and audio output are for intercom use and need licence 003801.
Power consumption is max. 145 W without encoder boards and max. 170 W with 3 encoder boards.
Dimensions are with feet; height without feet is 122 mm.
Weight is stated with 2 hard disks.
